name: Rábapordány (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábapordány: a green shield with a white star, a sabre and an arm, with a crest of ears of grain, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed RÁBAPORDÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Rábapordány arms with crest, wreath and scroll
